attacker_pocs.name: negative_zero_offset
attacker_pocs.why: A valid negative zero-hour offset reaches TimeValue::read through its public string API. The offset sign pointer refers to a destroyed temporary substring and is read after its lifetime ends.

role_a_rationale: TimeValue now derives the timezone minute sign from the raw offset and handles both extended and basic negative zero-hour offsets. Focused behavior assertions passed in a normal build. The sign extraction creates one dangling pointer read from a temporary substring, which ASan reports on valid input in debug and optimized builds; the parent exits cleanly. The source edit is confined to src/value.cpp and its focused test.
